protocol.name: PBM — Depression (Schiffer 2009, high-irradiance)

protocol.name: PBM — Anxiety (Wang 2023, high-irradiance)
protocol.description: 820nm PBM to the left DLPFC for generalized anxiety, as Wang 2023 ran it (double-blind sham-controlled RCT, n=36, 33 analysed): a continuous-wave laser at 310 mW/cm², a 1 cm spot at F5, four 4-minute exposures a day 5 minutes apart, on 14 consecutive days. HAMA fell more than sham (p=0.021) and stayed lower at 8 weeks; HAMA response 11/16 active vs 2/17 sham. Grade B. One session here is one day of that course; the 14-day schedule is the user's to keep, since the language has no course field. REFUSED ON THIS HARDWARE TODAY: the validator still caps duty at 25% (OI-HEXTILE-31) and U4 cannot yet conduct CW (OI-HEXTILE-30).
